description: Build a compact macro briefing for a currency by combining catalogue, key macro series, release-calendar, prediction, news, risk-sentiment, COT, seasonality, and FX technical context. Set depth for one indicator, a regime classification, a research pack, or a short spoken news answer. Access: USD needs no API key; other currencies return subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: depth='research_pack' only: pair base currency for pair context.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur. Required unless depth='spoken' (USD, EUR and GBP when omitted).

depth.description: brief (default) gives the compact currency briefing. indicator gives the latest value, trend and catalysts for one indicator. regime classifies the macro regime with evidence. research_pack builds a reusable context block for one indicator. spoken answers 'tell me the economic news' with sourced plain text to read aloud.

end_date.description: Not used by depth='brief': inclusive upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD.

indicator.description: Indicator slug from the catalogue. Required for depth='indicator' and depth='research_pack'.

quote.description: depth='research_pack' only: pair quote currency for pair context.

start_date.description: Not used by depth='brief': inclusive lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: macro_briefing_task
title: Macro Briefing
